reasons: query1 selects postgresql.tup_inserted with otel_metric_type="gauge", but the definition is a monotonic sum and the dataset only has sum types, so the selector matches nothing and rate() is applied to a non-sum.

The $db (prefix db) and $host (prefix host) template variables are dropped, but they should become matchers such as postgresql_database_name=~"$db" and host_name=~"$host"; the candidate therefore covers a wider set of series than the Datadog request.

The Datadog queries are plain avg() with no rate function, yet all three candidate queries wrap the counter in rate(...[$__rate_interval]), which changes the aggregation from the raw counter to a per-second rate unless the Datadog metric is itself a rate; this needs confirming before the translation is accepted.
Mapping rows_* to tup_* (tuples inserted/updated/deleted) is a reasonable quantity match and the by {db} grouping maps to postgresql_database_name, so the translated outcome itself is appropriate.
